quarterly_data.quarter: NVIDIA press release: NVIDIA Launches Open Agent Safety Platform to Secure Agents (09-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: NVIDIA launched the NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform: NVIDIA OpenShell open-source secure runtime software (now broadly available via the NVIDIA developer resources page and GitHub), which traces agent actions and enforces policy as agents run on NVIDIA Vera CPUs (extendable to Arm and Intel platforms), plus the NVIDIA Sentry reference system design, an out-of-band watchdog running on NVIDIA BlueField-4 DPUs (built on DOCA) that monitors agent behavior and can quarantine agents in milliseconds. Named adopters: SpaceXAI is using the platform for Cursor coding agents and Grok models; Scale AI is incorporating it into Scale GenAI Portfolio; SAP is embedding OpenShell in the Joule Studio runtime; Salesforce integrated OpenShell with Slack; Red Hat runs OpenShell and DOCA on Red Hat AI Factory with NVIDIA; Anthropic integrated Claude Managed Agents with OpenShell and BlueField. Over 100 organizations are working with the platform's technologies. CEO Jensen Huang: 'Safety and security require full-stack engineering.'
quarterly_data.figure: OpenShell broadly available; Sentry runs on BlueField-4 DPUs; over 100 organizations
